# gitmoap_user (Data Source)

Get a user by ID. Returns the person's public profile: id, username and avatar. Anyone may read it, without signing in; the email address is never part of it.

The token needs `user:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) User ID

### Read-Only

- `avatar` (String) The URL of the person's avatar image, when they have one.
- `closed` (Boolean) Whether the account was closed. A closed account whose record stays — because something it
wrote stays where other people work — has a generated username, `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, which no open account may take; the same shape names it wherever it appears as an
actor.
- `username` (String)
